title: [SESSION_127] PersonVehicleCorrelator: Implement Motion-Based Association (Phase 23)
body:
## Feature: Motion-Based Person-Vehicle Association

**Component:** PersonVehicleCorrelator (`/nodes/behavior_nodes/person_vehicle_correlator/`)
**Severity:** 🔴 CRITICAL BLOCKER
**Session:** SESSION 127 (Definition of Done)
**Current Status:** Uses only spatial distance, no velocity analysis
**Target Phase:** Phase 23

## Context

Distance-only association misses important behavioral context. A person approaching a vehicle has different significance than one passing by. Motion analysis distinguishes approach/entry from casual proximity.

## Requirements

- Track velocity vectors for persons and vehicles
- Detect approach vectors (moving toward vehicle)
- Distinguish entry/exit from passing by
- Calculate approach angle and speed
- Integrate motion into confidence scoring

## Impact

**Without this feature:**
- High false positives (30-40% incorrect associations)
- Cannot distinguish entry from proximity
- Reduced blacklist/investigation accuracy
- Unreliable person-vehicle tracking

## Effort Estimate

- Velocity calculation: 1.5 hours
- Motion analysis logic: 2-3 hours
- Testing: 1-1.5 hours
- **Total: 4-5 hours**

## Technical Approach

- 2D velocity estimation (frame-to-frame)
- Dot product for approach detection
- Distance rate-of-change analysis
- Confidence weighting by motion signals
